newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Suicide German pilot flies into mountain - agency.
newsitem.headline: Suicide German pilot flies into mountain - agency.

text.p: A German man committed suicide on Sunday by flying his light aircraft at full speed into the Zugspitze mountain range on Austria's border with Germany, Austrian news agency APA reported.
Security officials in the area said the German slammed his aircraft into the mountains in Austria's western province of Tyrol after taking off from Germany.
While in the air, he made clear his intention of committing suicide and resisted police efforts via radio to talk him down, APA said.
Neither the identity of the man nor his motive for committing suicide were known.
